OpenVINO Model Server
Usage:
  /ovms/bin/ovms [OPTION...]

  -h, --help                    Show this help message and exit
      --version                 Show binary version
      --port PORT               gRPC server port (default: 0)
      --grpc_bind_address GRPC_BIND_ADDRESS
                                Network interface address to bind to for 
                                the gRPC API (default: 0.0.0.0)
      --rest_port REST_PORT     REST server port, the REST server will not 
                                be started if rest_port is blank or set to 
                                0 (default: 0)
      --rest_bind_address REST_BIND_ADDRESS
                                Network interface address to bind to for 
                                the REST API (default: 0.0.0.0)
      --grpc_workers GRPC_WORKERS
                                Number of gRPC servers. Default 1. Increase 
                                for multi client, high throughput scenarios 
                                (default: 1)
      --grpc_max_threads GRPC_MAX_THREADS
                                Maximum number of threads which can be used 
                                by the gRPC server. Default value depends 
                                on number of CPUs.
      --grpc_memory_quota GRPC_MEMORY_QUOTA
                                GRPC server buffer memory quota. Default 
                                value set to 2147483648 (2GB).
      --rest_workers REST_WORKERS
                                Number of worker threads in REST server - 
                                has no effect if rest_port is not set. 
                                Default value depends on number of CPUs. 
      --log_level LOG_LEVEL     serving log level - one of TRACE, DEBUG, 
                                INFO, WARNING, ERROR (default: INFO)
      --log_path LOG_PATH       Optional path to the log file
      --verbose_response        When enabled, responses include an extra 
                                "__verbose" object with additional debug 
                                information.
      --disable_input_count_validation
                                When enabled, OVMS allows inference 
                                requests to include additional, 
                                unrecognized inputs beyond the 
                                model/pipeline signature (extra inputs are 
                                ignored). Required inputs must still be 
                                present, and shape/precision validation is 
                                still performed for recognized inputs. 
                                Default: false (extra inputs cause the 
                                request to be rejected).
      --grpc_channel_arguments GRPC_CHANNEL_ARGUMENTS
                                A comma separated list of arguments to be 
                                passed to the gRPC server. (e.g. 
                                grpc.max_connection_age_ms=2000)
      --file_system_poll_wait_seconds FILE_SYSTEM_POLL_WAIT_SECONDS
                                Time interval between config and model 
                                versions changes detection. Default is 1. 
                                Zero or negative value disables changes 
                                monitoring. (default: 1)
      --idle_unload_timeout_seconds IDLE_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                                Idle timeout in seconds for model group 
                                unloading. When > 0, models not in the 
                                'permanent' group are loaded on demand and 
                                unloaded after this idle period. Only 
                                effective with config.json multi-model 
                                setup. Default is 0 (disabled). (default: 
                                0)
      --custom_node_resources_cleaner_interval_seconds CUSTOM_NODE_RESOURCES_CLEANER_INTERVAL_SECONDS
                                Time interval between two consecutive 
                                resources cleanup scans. Default is 300. 
                                Zero value disables resources cleaner. 
                                (default: 300)
      --cache_dir CACHE_DIR     Overrides model cache directory. By default 
                                cache files are saved into/opt/cache if the 
                                directory is present. When enabled, first 
                                model load will produce cache files.
      --metrics_enable          Flag enabling metrics endpoint on 
                                rest_port.
      --metrics_list METRICS_LIST
                                Comma separated list of metrics. If unset, 
                                only default metrics will be enabled. 
                                Default metrics: ovms_requests_success, 
                                ovms_requests_fail, ovms_request_time_us, 
                                ovms_streams, ovms_inference_time_us, 
                                ovms_wait_for_infer_req_time_us. When set, 
                                only the listed metrics will be enabled. 
                                Optional metrics: 
                                ovms_infer_req_queue_size, 
                                ovms_infer_req_active. (default: "")
      --cpu_extension CPU_EXTENSION
                                A path to shared library containing custom 
                                CPU layer implementation. Default: empty. 
                                (default: "")
      --allowed_media_domains ALLOWED_MEDIA_DOMAINS
                                Comma separated list of media domains from 
                                which URLs can be used as input for LLMs. 
                                Set to "all" to disable this restriction.
      --allowed_local_media_path ALLOWED_LOCAL_MEDIA_PATH
                                Path to directory that contains multimedia 
                                files that can be used as input for LLMs.
      --allow_credentials       Flag enabling credentials on the API.
      --allowed_origins ALLOWED_ORIGINS
                                Comma separated list of origins that are 
                                allowed to access the API. Default: *. 
                                (default: *)
      --allowed_methods ALLOWED_METHODS
                                Comma separated list of methods that are 
                                allowed to access the API. Default: *. 
                                (default: *)
      --allowed_headers ALLOWED_HEADERS
                                Comma separated list of headers that are 
                                allowed to access the API. Default: *. 
                                (default: *)
      --api_key_file API_KEY    path to the text file containing API key 
                                for authentication for generative 
                                endpoints. If not set, authentication is 
                                disabled. (default: "")

 multi model options:
      --config_path CONFIG_PATH
                                Absolute path to json configuration file

 single model options:
      --model_name MODEL_NAME   Name of the model
      --model_path MODEL_PATH   Folder with AI model versions or with 
                                mediapipe graph
      --batch_size BATCH_SIZE   Resets models batchsize, int value or auto. 
                                This parameter will be ignored if shape is 
                                set
      --shape SHAPE             Resets models shape (model must support 
                                reshaping). If set, batch_size parameter is 
                                ignored
      --layout LAYOUT           Resets model layout. It should be in format 
                                <TARGET_LAYOUT>:<SOURCE_LAYOUT> e.g. 
                                NCHW:NHWC
      --mean MEAN               Resets model mean.
      --scale SCALE             Resets model scale.
      --color_format COLOR_FORMAT
                                Resets model color format. It should be in 
                                format 
                                <TARGET_COLOR_FORMAT>:<SOURCE_COLOR_FORMAT> 
                                e.g. BGR:RGB
      --precision PRECISION     Resets model precision.
      --model_version_policy MODEL_VERSION_POLICY
                                Model version policy
      --nireq NIREQ             Size of inference request queue for model 
                                executions. Recommended to be >= parallel 
                                executions. Default value calculated by 
                                OpenVINO based on available resources. 
                                Request for 0 is treated as request for 
                                default value
      --target_device TARGET_DEVICE
                                Target device to run the inference. 
                                Default: auto-detected based on available 
                                devices. (default: "")
      --plugin_config PLUGIN_CONFIG
                                A dictionary of plugin configuration keys 
                                and their values, eg "{\"NUM_STREAMS\": 
                                \"1\"}". Default number of streams is 
                                optimized to optimal latency with low 
                                concurrency.

 pull hf model options:
      --pull                    Pull model from HF. Uses optional 
                                environment variables: HF_TOKEN - when set 
                                used for authentication, HF_ENDPOINT - when 
                                set replaces huggingface.co for model 
                                download.
      --source_model HF_SOURCE  HF source model path
      --source_loras SOURCE_LORAS
                                LoRA adapters for image generation. Format: 
                                alias1=org1/repo1,alias2=org2/repo2@file.saf
                                etensors,alias3=https://url/file.safetensors
                                ,alias4=/local/path/file.safetensors
      --gguf_filename GGUF_FILENAME
                                Name of the GGUF file
      --overwrite_models        Overwrite the model if it already exists in 
                                the models repository
      --model_repository_path MODEL_REPOSITORY_PATH
                                HF model destination download path 
                                (default: "")
      --weight-format WEIGHT_FORMAT
                                Model precision used in optimum-cli export 
                                with conversion (default: int8)
      --extra_quantization_params EXTRA_QUANTIZATION_PARAMS
                                Model quantization parameters used in 
                                optimum-cli export with conversion for text 
                                generation models

 generative task (applies to: pull hf model, configure, single model) options:
      --task TASK  Specifies the generative task for the local model. It 
                   should be followed by task specific parameters. 
                   Supported tasks: text_generation, embeddings, rerank, 
                   image_generation, text2speech, speech2text. It creates 
                   the pipeline graph in memory based on the provided 
                   task-specific options. If not provided, default task 
                   value is inferred from model config.
      --configure  Create or update graph.pbtxt for the model specified by 
                   --model_path and --task. Does not start the server.

configure mode (create or update graph.pbtxt for a local model):
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task <TASK> [TASK OPTIONS ...]

config management commands:
Usage:
  ovms --add_to_config --config_path <CONFIG_PATH> --model_name <MODEL_NAME> --model_repository_path <MODEL_REPO_PATH> 
  ovms --add_to_config --config_path <CONFIG_PATH> --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --model_name <MODEL_NAME> --group_name <GROUP> 
  ovms --remove_from_config --config_path <CONFIG_PATH> --model_name <MODEL_NAME>

 config management options:
      --list_models             Directive to show available servables in 
                                models repository
      --add_to_config           Directive to add a model to configuration 
                                file. This parameter should be executed 
                                with --model_name, --config_path and either 
                                with --model_path or 
                                --model_repository_path.
      --remove_from_config      Directive to remove a model from 
                                configuration file. This parameter should 
                                be executed with --config_path and 
                                --model_name to specify which model to 
                                remove.
      --model_repository_path MODEL_REPOSITORY_PATH
                                Absolute or relative path from the config 
                                directory to the model repository (default: 
                                "")
      --model_path MODEL_PATH   Absolute or relative path from the config 
                                directory to the model. By default is a 
                                combination of the model_repository_path 
                                and model_name.
      --model_name MODEL_NAME   Name of the model
      --group_name GROUP_NAME   Optional group name for idle model group 
                                management
      --config_path CONFIG_PATH
                                Path to json configuration file (default: 
                                "")

--task text_generation options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task text_generation [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task text_generation [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 text generation options:
      --max_num_seqs MAX_NUM_SEQS
                                The maximum number of sequences that can be 
                                processed together. Default 256. (default: 
                                256)
      --pipeline_type PIPELINE_TYPE
                                Type of the pipeline to be used: Choices 
                                LM, LM_CB, VLM, VLM_CB, AUTO. AUTO is used 
                                by default.
      --enable_prefix_caching ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHING
                                This algorithm is used to cache the prompt 
                                tokens. (default: true)
      --max_num_batched_tokens MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS
                                empty or integer. The maximum number of 
                                tokens that can be batched together.
      --cache_size CACHE_SIZE   KV cache size in GB, default is 0 which 
                                mean dynamic allocation. (default: 0)
      --draft_source_model DRAFT_SOURCE_MODEL
                                HF model name or path to the local folder 
                                with PyTorch or OpenVINO draft model.
      --draft_model_path DRAFT_MODEL_PATH
                                Absolute path to an already-exported 
                                OpenVINO draft model directory (use instead 
                                of --draft_source_model for local models).
      --draft_device DRAFT_DEVICE
                                Device to run the draft model on. Defaults 
                                to the same device as the main model.
      --draft_eagle3_mode       [Deprecated] Draft model strategy is now 
                                auto-detected from model artifacts; this 
                                flag is accepted but ignored.
      --dynamic_split_fuse DYNAMIC_SPLIT_FUSE
                                Dynamic split fuse algorithm enabled. 
                                Default true. (default: true)
      --reasoning_parser REASONING_PARSER
                                Reasoning parser
      --tool_parser TOOL_PARSER
                                Tool parser
      --enable_tool_guided_generation ENABLE_TOOL_GUIDED_GENERATION
                                Enables enforcing tool schema during 
                                generation. Requires setting tool parser. 
                                Default: false. (default: false)
      --cache_interval_multiplier CACHE_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER
                                Multiplier for the KV cache block interval. 
                                Controls the granularity of cache 
                                allocation. Default: unset.

 plugin config options:
      --max_prompt_len MAX_PROMPT_LEN
                                Sets NPU specific property for maximum 
                                number of tokens in the prompt.
      --kv_cache_precision KV_CACHE_PRECISION
                                u8 or empty (model default). Reduced kv 
                                cache precision to u8 lowers the cache size 
                                consumption. (default: "")
      --model_distribution_policy MODEL_DISTRIBUTION_POLICY
                                TENSOR_PARALLEL, PIPELINE_PARALLEL or empty 
                                (model default). Sets model distribution 
                                policy for inference with multiple 
                                sockets/devices.

--task rerank options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task rerank [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task rerank [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 rerank options:
      --num_streams NUM_STREAMS
                                The number of parallel execution streams to 
                                use for the model. Use at least 2 on 2 
                                socket CPU systems. (default: 1)
      --max_allowed_chunks MAX_ALLOWED_CHUNKS
                                Maximum allowed chunks. (default: 10000)

--task embeddings options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task embeddings [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task embeddings [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 embeddings options:
      --num_streams NUM_STREAMS
                                The number of parallel execution streams to 
                                use for the model. Use at least 2 on 2 
                                socket CPU systems. (default: 1)
      --normalize NORMALIZE     Normalize the embeddings. (default: true)
      --truncate truncate       Truncate input when it exceeds model 
                                context length. (default: false)
      --pooling POOLING         Pooling option. One of: CLS, LAST, MEAN. If 
                                omitted, OVMS will detect pooling 
                                automatically.
      --max_length MAX_LENGTH   Maximum input length in tokens. If omitted, 
                                OVMS will detect it from the model's 
                                config.json.

--task image_generation options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task image_generation [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task image_generation [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 image_generation options:
      --resolution RESOLUTION   Allowed resolutions in a format list of 
                                WxH; W=width H=height - space separated. If 
                                not specified, inherited from model. If one 
                                is specified, the pipeline will be reshaped 
                                to static.
      --max_resolution MAX_RESOLUTION
                                Max allowed resolution in a format of WxH; 
                                W=width H=height. If not specified, 
                                inherited from model.
      --default_resolution DEFAULT_RESOLUTION
                                Default resolution when not specified by 
                                client in a format of WxH; W=width 
                                H=height. If not specified, inherited from 
                                model.
      --num_images_per_prompt NUM_IMAGES_PER_PROMPT
                                Number of images client is allowed to 
                                request. Can only be used when resolution 
                                parameter is specified and static. By 
                                default, inherited from GenAI (1).
      --guidance_scale GUIDANCE_SCALE
                                Guidance scale used for static pipeline 
                                reshape. Can only be used when resolution 
                                parameter is specified and static. By 
                                default, inherited from GenAI (7.5).
      --max_num_images_per_prompt MAX_NUM_IMAGES_PER_PROMPT
                                Max allowed number of images client is 
                                allowed to request for a given prompt.
      --default_num_inference_steps DEFAULT_NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS
                                Default number of inference steps when not 
                                specified by client.
      --max_num_inference_steps MAX_NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS
                                Max allowed number of inference steps 
                                client is allowed to request for a given 
                                prompt.
      --num_streams NUM_STREAMS
                                The number of parallel execution streams to 
                                use for the image generation models. Use at 
                                least 2 on 2 socket CPU systems.

--task text2speech options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task text2speech [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task text2speech [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 TextToSpeech options:
      --num_streams NUM_STREAMS
                                The number of parallel execution streams to 
                                use for the model. Use at least 2 on 2 
                                socket CPU systems. (default: 1)
      --model_type MODEL_TYPE   Type of the source TTS model: speecht5 
                                (default) or kokoro. (default: speecht5)
      --vocoder VOCODER         The vocoder model to use for text2speech. 
                                For example microsoft/speecht5_hifigan, 
                                used only with export via optimum-cli.

--task speech2text options
Usage:
  ovms --pull --task speech2text [OPTIONS...]
  ovms --configure --model_path <MODEL_PATH> --task speech2text [OPTIONS...] [OPTION...]

 SpeechToText options:
      --num_streams NUM_STREAMS
                                The number of parallel execution streams to 
                                use for the model. Use at least 2 on 2 
                                socket CPU systems. (default: 1)
